tailoring.headline: Expert SAP Commerce Developer & Techno-Functional Analyst | Java, Spring & E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms, Promotions Engine, and customer accounts for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, and order management, with proven delivery of data and API integrations. Works in a techno-functional role between business and IT: requirements analysis, user stories, process mapping, and extensive use of AI tools in analysis and documentation. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Expert Business Analyst - Checkout (all genders)
cover_en.hook: ABOUT YOU's innovative SCAYLE platform and its focus on scaling enterprise e-commerce across European retailers make this Expert Business Analyst role an exciting opportunity. Bringing over 5 years of hands-on e-commerce experience building promotions, customer accounts, and backend workflows at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bridge business requirements and technical execution for your checkout teams.

bullets.label: Promotions & Customer Accounts
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core e-commerce modules including the Promotions Engine, customer account structures, and order management (OMS) during my tenure at Shell and Rockwell Automation.

bullets.label: Requirements & Feature Analysis
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role bridging business stakeholders and technical teams: analysed business requirements, authored user stories, functional specifications, and mapped end-to-end processes.

bullets.label: API & Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, ensuring seamless data flows across global e-commerce channels and third-party consumer systems.

bullets.label: Stakeholder & International Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with international business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to investigate integration bottlenecks, support UAT, and translate business needs into scalable solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my techno-functional e-commerce expertise can support SCAYLE Checkout.

tailoring.why_company: ABOUT YOU's SCAYLE commerce engine stands out for its high-performance architecture, multi-tenant approach, and commitment to shaping the future of European e-commerce. As an engineer with deep SAP Commerce experience bridging business requirements and technical execution, I am inspired by SCAYLE's focus on scalable checkout solutions and data-driven innovation across multiple retail brands.
tailoring.motivation_short: I bring 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce, promotions, and customer account experience, combining technical depth in Java and APIs with strong techno-functional requirements analysis.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms, promotions engines, and customer accounts at Rockwell Automation and Shell, plus strong techno-functional analysis experience, I am very interested in the Expert Business Analyst - Checkout role at SCAYLE. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Expert Business Analyst - Checkout - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Expert Business Analyst - Checkout position at ABOUT YOU SE & Co. KG.

With over 5 years of professional experience in enterprise e-commerce platforms, promotions engines, customer accounts, and techno-functional requirements analysis across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute to the SCAYLE Checkout teams.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
